import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 2345678;

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int total_input = sc.nextInt();
        int max_select = sc.nextInt();

        double[] p_real = new double[total_input];
        double[] p_vals = new double[total_input];
        int[] position = new int[total_input];
        double[] answer = new double[total_input];

        int count_valid = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < total_input; i++) {
            p_real[i] = sc.nextDouble();
            if (p_real[i] > 1e-4) {
                position[count_valid] = i;
                p_vals[count_valid] = p_real[i];
                count_valid++;
            }
        }

        max_select = Math.min(max_select, count_valid);

        int[] popcount = new int[1 << count_valid];
        double[] dp = new double[1 << count_valid];

        popcount[0] = 0;
        for (int mask = 1; mask < (1 << count_valid); mask++) {
            popcount[mask] = popcount[mask & (mask - 1)] + 1;
        }

        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << count_valid); mask++) {
            dp[mask] = 0.0;
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < total_input; i++) {
            answer[i] = 0.0;
        }

        dp[0] = 1.0;

        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << count_valid); mask++) {
            if (popcount[mask] == max_select) {
                for (int j = 0; j < count_valid; j++) {
                    if ((mask & (1 << j)) != 0) {
                        answer[position[j]] += dp[mask];
                    }
                }
                continue;
            }
            double sum_p = 0.0;
            for (int j = 0; j < count_valid; j++) {
                if ((mask & (1 << j)) != 0) continue;
                sum_p += p_vals[j];
            }
            double ratio = sum_p > 0 ? dp[mask] / sum_p : 0;
            for (int j = 0; j < count_valid; j++) {
                if ((mask & (1 << j)) != 0) continue;
                dp[mask | (1 << j)] += p_vals[j] * ratio;
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < total_input; i++) {
            if (i > 0) System.out.print(" ");
            System.out.printf("%.17f", answer[i]);
        }
        System.out.println();
        sc.close();
    }
}
